sun_distance.unit: km, from the centre of the Moon

paths: file names are relative to data/
frame: MOON_ME (x towards the mean Earth direction, z the north pole), origin at the centre of the Moon
content: sample i is the moment start + i * step_h. sun_x..z: unit vector to the Sun; earth_x..z_km: position of the centre of the Earth. Apparent positions (light time and stellar aberration, LT+S), as in backend/ephem.py
source: NAIF SPICE kernels de440s.bsp, moon_pa_de440_200625.bpc, moon_de440_250416.tf, pck00011.tpc, naif0012.tls
